title: Sensor 2 Supply Voltage High Error
detail_of_failure: High voltage is sensed in sensor 2 power supply circuit.
controller_action: • Operates with charge pressure and charge temperature as fixed value. • Operates the machine with the engine output limited.
machine_effect: • Engine output is reduced. • Startability deteriorates.
related_information: After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Do the troubleshooting for failure code [CA187].
